counter_probe_anchor_falsifier.scope: retrieval-side construction of the counter-authority probe's topic anchor
contaminated_bundles: 39275520116/questions/de-kapitalverletzung.bundle.json (11 placeholder occurrences in the answer prose)
39319405429/questions/de-kapitalverletzung.bundle.json (9 placeholder occurrences in the answer prose)
counter_probe_anchor_falsifier.finding: The product's counter-authority stage anchors every issued probe on the first four key terms of the ANSWER PROSE (product/query/adversarial_retrieval.py::plan_adversarial_queries, `probe_terms = key_terms[:4] + terms`), and the generative audit rewrites that prose first, replacing every ungrounded citation with the literal placeholder '[citation removed: not in retrieved set]'. The placeholder's own tokens survive the product's own stoplist and length filter ('citation', 'removed', 'retrieved'), so when the answer carries enough placeholder occurrences they displace the real legal vocabulary out of the four anchor slots. In the German bundle of packet 39319405429 the issued probe reads 'citation removed retrieved nicht ...' and the anchor shares NO content term with the question it is supposed to attack; in the German bundle of packet 39275520116 three of the four anchor slots are placeholder tokens. The FR and IT bundles of the same packets are clean, so the defect is not a language artefact. The de-redaction counterfactual isolates the placeholder as the cause: removing ONLY the placeholder occurrences from the answer prose changes the anchor to 'nicht fuer... ' / 'fuer... arbeitgeber ...' and restores a topical anchor, while for every bundle without a placeholder the de-redaction is a no-op. All five non-vacuity controls pass, including byte-for-byte replay of every recorded probe query by the product's own planner (14/14).
counter_probe_anchor_falsifier.why_this_is_not_a_duplication: The accepted counter-emission attribution covers cause classes c_HYDRATION and e_EMISSION_WRITER_ABORT only, i.e. LABEL-side causes, and the accepted cross-check 39457963802 compares the label stage only (ZERO_DIVERGENCE over 96 comparable quantities). Neither looks at how the probe is built, and no instrument in evaluation/ reads the probe anchor. This is the first RETRIEVAL-side measurement of the counter probe.
counter_probe_anchor_falsifier.product_handoff: A PRODUCT defect, not an evaluation defect; the fix belongs to the product lane and this lane's write scope forbids touching product code. Either (a) exclude the redaction placeholder from the probe key terms in product/query/adversarial_retrieval.py (strip REDACTION_PLACEHOLDER from the prose before answer_key_terms, or exclude the placeholder's tokens from the candidate set) - the smaller change, and it keeps the audit's redaction intact - or (b) plan the probes from the PRE-redaction prose by reordering product/query/pipeline.py so adversarial_retrieval_pass sees the prose the answer was written from. Option (b) alone does not help if the answer itself lacks legal vocabulary, so (a) is the recommended remedy.
counter_probe_anchor_falsifier.claim_ceiling: Establishes exactly one thing: on the accepted product's recorded counter-probe queries, whether the topic anchor contains a token the product's own key-term extractor derives from the generative audit's redaction placeholder, and whether the de-redaction counterfactual changes that anchor. NOT a label-emission measurement, NOT a counter-authority recall measurement against any frozen known-counter set, NOT a LABEL_SOUND or GEOMETRY_SOUND claim (both stay REPORTED-ONLY), NOT a serve recommendation, NOT a jurist-usefulness or map claim. The reported adversarial-row topicality rates are OBSERVATIONAL (the counterfactual cannot re-run the live retrieval) and are reported with numerator and denominator and no threshold. Lifts no DO-NOT-SERVE order; packet admission stays fail-closed; human_gate_ready and owner_decision_required stay false. No universal-174k benchmark was run.
